mapper.select: SELECT tt.*, concat_ws( '-', tt.PAYMENT_REQ_NUMBER, tt.bp_name, '放款资料清单' ) fileName FROM ( SELECT ppa.CSH_ATTCAHMENT_ID attachment_id, ppa.PAYMENT_REQ_ID, ppa.document_name, ppa.description, ( SELECT hd.PAYMENT_REQ_NUMBER FROM csh_payment_req_hd hd WHERE hd.payment_Req_id = ppa.PAYMENT_REQ_ID ) PAYMENT_REQ_NUMBER,( SELECT hbm.bp_name FROM hls_bp_master hbm WHERE hbm.bp_id = ( SELECT p.tenant_id FROM prj_project p WHERE p.project_id =( SELECT hd.SOURCE_DOC_ID FROM csh_payment_req_hd hd WHERE hd.payment_Req_id = ppa.PAYMENT_REQ_ID ))) bp_name, ( SELECT wm_concat( fa.file_name ) FROM fnd_atm_attachment fa, fnd_atm_attachment_multi fam WHERE fa.attachment_id = fam.attachment_id AND fam.table_name = 'csh_payment_attachment' AND ppa.csh_attcahment_id = fam.table_pk_value ) AS modelName FROM csh_payment_attachment ppa WHERE ppa.project_attachment_category = 'CON_PAYMENT' AND ppa.PAYMENT_REQ_ID = #{paymentReqId} ) tt
